incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: sudden KV cache growth observed in inference pool 'eu-west-1-rt-1' after speculative-decoding rollout. 95th p90 token latency +200ms, 5xx rate rising from 0.2% -> 3.8% across chat endpoints. Paging on-call.

alex_oncall: Paging in — looking now. Which deploy rolled speculative decode? @sam_ml do you have the rollout id?

sam_ml: rolled spec-decode flag to 100% on eu-west-1 at 02:18 UTC, rollout id `sd-roll-20260301-7`. We also adjusted continuous-batching to higher batch size (max_batch_tokens=8192) in same change window for throughput tests.

maria_sre: seeing KV cache size climb in metrics (per-shard kv_entries) and cache eviction thrashing. Looks like speculative decoding is generating many unique prefixes that miss KV cache, causing cache blowup and eviction storms.

tami_prod: customers reporting elevated latencies in support. Early reports from orgs: org-632 (chatbot), org-141 (search rerank). No complete outages yet but a few timeouts.

alex_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable speculative decoding flag 2) reduce continuous-batching max tokens to previous safe value 3) scale inference pool if needed. I'll try 1 & 2 now. Confirming service impact window.

sam_ml: ack — speculative decoding off will reduce throughput but should stabilize cache usage. Flag keys:

```
redwoodctl feature-flag set speculative_decoding.enabled false --env prod --region eu-west-1
infractl set config eu-west-1-rt-1 batching.max_batch_tokens 4096 --commit "hotfix rollback batching"
```

rishi_runtime: if we flip flags we should also enable immediate cache trimming to free memory: `runtimectl cache trim --since 0h30m --pool eu-west-1-rt-1` — will run after deploy.

alex_oncall: running flag disable now.

deploy-bot: starting rollout: redwoodctl feature-flag set speculative_decoding.enabled=false (id: ff-1762054330). Target: eu-west-1. Gradual 20% -> 100% with health checks.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% completed at 1762054362. Health checks: increased 5xx -> stabilized within first 2 min.

alex_oncall: applying batching rollback.

deploy-bot: infractl commit created: cb-hotfix-1762054380. Applying to cluster eu-west-1-rt-1.

deploy-bot: infractl apply completed at 1762054410. New `batching.max_batch_tokens`=4096.

maria_sre: metrics after both mitigations: KV cache entries leveling off, eviction rate down 80%, p95 latency returning toward baseline. 5xx rate trending down to ~0.5%.

eric_support: support update: notified affected customers (org-632, org-141) with ETA for full recovery. They reported transient errors for ~7-12 minutes. No data loss.

tami_prod: thanks. Please file incident page and start timeline. Add customer impact notes for SLAs.

alex_oncall: created incident page: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-031 (draft). Adding timeline and commands.

sam_ml: root cause hypothesis: speculative decoding synthesizes candidate continuations which are inserted into early KV cache lookups for draft tokens; combined with a larger batch token cap it causes many unique KV prefixes to be materialized in cache, leading to blowup and eviction churn. The cache divergence happens because speculative drafts are not deduped/merged with final target sequences quickly.

rishi_runtime: agree. We should change speculative-decoding integration to avoid populating KV cache for draft-only prefixes or use a draft namespace that is trimmed aggressively.

maria_sre: short-term actions:
- keep speculative_decoding disabled in prod for eu-west-1
- roll batching config back globally if other regions also have changes pending
- add automated alert on kv_entries_growth_rate > X
- run load test to confirm no regression

alex_oncall: I've pushed a global policy to pause further speculative decode rollouts. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4317

deploy-bot: policy/enforcement updated at 1762054520.

tami_prod: notify customers of root-cause and mitigation once postmortem is ready. Prioritize org-632 SLA review.

eric_support: queued follow-up emails and asked for log bundles from affected customers.

alex_oncall: handing off to night on-call @maria_sre. Current status: mitigations applied, metrics stabilizing, monitoring on. Handoff notes in incident page.

maria_sre: taking over. Key things for next shift: keep speculative flag disabled, watch KV cache growth and eviction rate, validate that rollout blocks are enforced. If we see re-spike, escalate to platform pager and run emergency scale commands:

```
infractl scale cluster eu-west-1-rt-1 --gpus +2 --reason "incident mitigation"
runtimectl cache trim --pool eu-west-1-rt-1 --target-size 30GB
```

alex_oncall: thanks — adding contact matrix: @rishi_runtime for runtime fixes, @sam_ml for model integration changes, @tami_prod for customer comms.

maria_sre: acknowledged. I'll run a focused canary with speculative decoding disabled+old batching tomorrow morning and request a deeper postmortem. Please attach any logs/graphs to the incident page.

sam_ml: I'll start a design doc for speculative-decoding KV handling (draft namespace vs dedupe) and include perf tests. Link will go to incident page.

tami_prod: good. Make sure to call out potential perf cliffs for customers using long-context flows.

alex_oncall: final: incident declared mitigated at 1762054675. Keep as sev-2 until postmortem. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: closing rotation notes. Next steps: postmortem, code changes to prevent cache materialization for drafts, add alerting, customer comms. Handed off at 1762054687.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=sev-2, incident_id=INC-2026-031, responders=[alex_oncall,maria_sre,rishi_runtime,sam_ml].
